# Launch screen image

Generated by `python tools/artgen/artgen.py` from `doc/designs/background.png`
(D290). Do not edit these files or drop replacements in from Xcode; the next
run overwrites them. Change the source art instead.

The forest here is already darkened by `ForestBackground`'s scrim (D296), so
the launch screen and the first Flutter frame are the same picture at the same
brightness and the hand-off between them is invisible.
